## :warning: Attention Required

- Log warning when default context configuration is ignored within test class hierarchies [#36390](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36390)
- Ignore flush calls on ServletServerHttpResponse body outputstream [#36385](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36385)

## :star: New Features

- Leverage `ResourceHandlerUtils` in `ScriptTemplateView` [#36458](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36458)
- Restore `ScriptTemplateViewTests` [#36456](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36456)
- Fix log message in `ConfigurationClassBeanDefinitionReader` [#36453](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36453)
- DefaultResponseErrorHandler - setMessageConverters() not called via RestClient [#36434](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36434)
- Resolve context initializers only once in `AbstractTestContextBootstrapper` [#36430](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36430)
- Invoke `resolveContextLoader()` only once in `AbstractTestContextBootstrapper` [#36425](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36425)
- Further align synthesized annotation `toString()` with modern JDKs [#36417](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36417)
- Introduce `setDefaultCharset()` in `AbstractResourceBasedMessageSource` [#36413](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36413)
- Support for JPA 4.0 flush mode "explicit" [#36401](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36401)
- Support application-wide defaultHtmlEscape setting in WebFlux RequestContext [#36400](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36400)
- Support `Predicate<RequestPath>>` in path API version resolver [#36398](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36398)
- Avoid duplicate flushes in HttpMessageConverter implementations [#36383](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36383)
- Add support for non-flushing OutputStream to StreamUtils [#36382](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36382)
- Make it easier to get InputStream from RestClient [#36380](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36380)
- RuntimeHintsWriter should comply with reachability-metadata-schema-v1.2.0.json [#36379](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36379)
- Make it easier to create custom HttpExchangeAdapter [#36374](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36374)
- Improve ResourceHttpMessageConverter target type support [#36368](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36368)
- org.springframework.test.web.servlet.assertj.AbstractHttpServletResponseAssert#headers case sensitivity [#36349](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36349)
- Allow registering serialized lambda metadata through RuntimeHints [#36339](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36339)
- Refactor calculateHashCode in RequestMappingInfo [#36325](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36325)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- MetadataReader misses enclosing class name for Kotlin nested classes with Java 24+ [#36451](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36451)
- Guard against invalid id/event values in Server Sent Events [#36440](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36440)
- Component scanning fails against non-loadable annotation type with enum array on Java 25 [#36432](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36432)
- Duplicate ServletServerHttpRequest headers [#36418](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36418)
- Incomplete debug message in ConfigurationClassBeanDefinitionReader [#36410](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36410)
- Inconsistent ApplicationEventMulticaster state after removing ApplicationListener implemented by FactoryBean [#36404](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36404)
- Propagate max frame length to WebSocket session [#36370](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36370)
- Graceful shutdown of SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor [#36362](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36362)
- Duplicate response headers with `ResponseEntity<Mono<T>>` (or Kotlin suspend function) controller method [#36357](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36357)
- HttpServiceProxyFactory returns LinkedHashMap instead of target type for method with generic return type [#36326](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36326)
- HttpMediaTypeException thrown when calculating compatible media types [#36300](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36300)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Document `FullyQualifiedConfigurationBeanNameGenerator` in Javadoc and reference docs [#36455](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36455)
- Document `@Fallback` alongside `Primary` in the reference manual and `@Bean` Javadoc [#36439](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36439)
- Fix links to `UriComponentsBuilder` and polish examples [#36403](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36403)
- Emphasize `@Configuration` classes over XML and Groovy in testing chapter [#36393](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36393)
- Document tips to avoid issues with ignored default context configuration in tests [#36392](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36392)
- Polish SpEL operator examples in reference docs [#36367](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36367)
- Add programmatic configuration tabs in the transactional refdoc [#36323](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36323)
- Document registration recommendations for `BeanPostProcessor` and `BeanFactoryPostProcessor` [#34964](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/34964)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to JUnit 6.0.3 [#36389](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36389)
- Upgrade to Micrometer 1.16.4 [#36444](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36444)
- Upgrade to Reactor 2025.0.4 [#36443](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36443)

## :heart: Contributors

Thank you to all the contributors who worked on this release:

@AgilAghamirzayev, @aavoronin93, @cetf9h, @froggy0m0, @gbouwen, @husseinvr97, @jisub-dev, @ngocnhan-tran1996, @siom79, and @xxxxxxjun

## :star: New Features

- Leverage `ResourceHandlerUtils` in `ScriptTemplateView` [#36459](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36459)

- Fix log message in `ConfigurationClassBeanDefinitionReader` [#36454](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36454)

- Exclude legacy `@javax.validation.Constraint` from convention-based annotation attribute override check [#36412](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36412)
- Optimize `MediaType(MediaType, Charset)` constructor [#36351](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36351)
- Optimize the addition of a charset to the MediaType in AbstractHttpMessageConverter [#36350](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36350)
- Consistent adaptation of HTTP headers on Servlet responses [#36345](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36345)
- Improve performance of validation groups determination in WebFlux [#36337](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36337)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Guard against invalid id/event values in Server Sent Events [#36442](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36442)

- Inconsistent ApplicationEventMulticaster state after removing ApplicationListener implemented by FactoryBean [#36405](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36405)
- Graceful shutdown of SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor [#36384](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36384)
- HttpMediaTypeException thrown when calculating compatible media types [#36363](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36363)
- ResolvableType#getGenerics() breaks serialization [#36347](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36347)
- Multipart upload leak on client abort (ByteBuf.release() not called) [#36327](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36327)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Document `@Fallback` alongside `Primary` in the reference manual and `@Bean` Javadoc [#36441](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36441)
- Document registration recommendations for `BeanPostProcessor` and `BeanFactoryPostProcessor` [#36436](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36436)
- Fix links to `UriComponentsBuilder` and polish examples [#36406](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36406)
- Emphasize `@Configuration` classes over XML and Groovy in testing chapter [#36394](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36394)
- Polish SpEL operator examples in reference docs [#36375](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36375)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to JUnit 5.14.3 [#36388](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36388)
- Upgrade to Micrometer 1.15.10 [#36446](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36446)
- Upgrade to Reactor 2024.0.16 [#36445](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36445)

## :warning: Attention Required

- Optimize request and response header handling in Spring MVC [#36334](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36334)

## :star: New Features

- Consistent adaptation of HTTP headers on Servlet responses [#36343](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36343)
- Copy methodAnnotations in MethodParameter copy constructor [#36342](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36342)
- Improve performance of validation groups determination in WebFlux [#36336](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36336)
- Reuse `AnnotatedMethod` annotation cache in derived instances [#36322](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36322)
- Optimize the addition of a charset to the MediaType in AbstractHttpMessageConverter [#36320](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36320)
- Optimize `MediaType(MediaType, Charset)` constructor [#36318](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36318)
- Detect all common size exceptions from Tomcat and Commons FileUpload 2.x [#36317](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36317)
- Consistently support `@Autowired` as a meta-annotation [#36315](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36315)
- Avoid duplicate `required` attribute lookup for `@Autowired` annotations [#36314](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36314)
- Cache `@ResponseBody` presence per controller class in `RequestResponseBodyMethodProcessor` [#36311](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36311)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- ResolvableType#getGenerics() breaks serialization [#36346](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36346)
- DefaultHttpMessageConverters not adding provided configurer [#36332](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36332)
- Restore early MessageConsumer creation for temporary queue [#36321](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36321)
- Multipart upload leak on client abort (ByteBuf.release() not called) [#36262](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36262)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Document that SpEL expressions using `Optional` with null-safe and Elvis operators are not compilable [#36331](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36331)
- Improve documentation of baseline API version to emphasize version must be supported [#36316](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36316)
- Stop referring to obsolete `ListenableFuture` in documentation [#36313](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36313)
- Stop referring to standard Java features as "Java 8" features in documentation [#36310](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36310)

## :heart: Contributors

Thank you to all the contributors who worked on this release:

@Niravil and @TAKETODAY

## :star: New Features

- Cache method annotations in `MethodParameter` and `AnnotatedMethod` [#36307](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36307)
- Consistently support `@Lazy` as a meta-annotation at arbitrary depths [#36306](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36306)
- Consistently support `@Validated` as a meta-annotation at arbitrary depths [#36305](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36305)
- Let developers disable default registrations in HttpMessageConverters [#36303](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36303)
- Log which HandlerInterceptor threw the exception [#36281](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36281)
- Improve performance of hashcode calculations for request mappings [#36279](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36279)
- Improve performance of HandlerMethod bean lookup [#36278](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36278)
- Improve performance of version mapping [#36276](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36276)
- Improve performance of single pattern request mappings [#36275](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36275)
- Improve performance of validation groups determination [#36274](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36274)
- Add `setPackagesToScan` configuration method to `LocalEntityManagerFactoryBean` [#36270](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36270)
- Remove outdated GraalVM substitution [#36257](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36257)
- Introduce `beforeRetry` callback with `RetryState` argument [#36245](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36245)
- Optimize NamedParameterUtils#buildValueArray by lazily fetching SqlParameter [#36230](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36230)
- Allow customization of the `ProxyFactory` in `HttpServiceProxyFactory` used to create HTTP service proxies [#36225](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36225)
- Consistently close streams through try-with-resources in FileCopyUtils [#36223](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36223)
- Use Java Files utilities in FileCopyUtils [#36221](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36221)
- SqlBinaryValue and SqlCharacterValue should support InputStream content with undetermined length [#36219](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36219)
- Support JtaTransactionManager and SpringBeanContainer configuration on HibernateJpaVendorAdapter [#36216](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36216)
- Add TaskCallback/Callable/Runnable wrapper for retryable tasks [#36208](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36208)
- Refine YamlProcessor to allow different empty values [#36207](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36207)
- Anticipate fixing Kotlin 2.3 compilation warning [#36203](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36203)
- Allow YAML processors to create a flattened map with nulls included [#36197](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36197)
- Use Reader.transferTo in FileCopyUtils [#36196](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36196)
- `DataBufferUtils.write()` with NettyDataBuffer on JDK 25 hangs indefinitely [#36184](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36184)
- Make SendToMethodReturnValueHandler and SubscriptionMethodReturnValueHandler customizable, to allow for pass-through of message headers [#36179](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36179)
- Introduce `RestClient.ResponseSpec#requiredBody` [#36173](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36173)
- Make scope fully configurable in BeanRegistry/BeanRegistrar [#36171](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36171)
- ConcurrencyThrottleSupport and thread interruption [#36167](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36167)
- Add overloaded sendAndReceive methods to JmsTemplate to use explicit response queue [#36162](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36162)
- WebClient (Reactor) attributes on Netty channel do not clear after connection release [#36158](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36158)
- Support HttpEntity on ContentRequestMatchers.multipartData [#36154](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36154)
- Reintroduce WebLogicJtaTransactionManager in Spring Framework 6.2.x [#36151](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36151)
- Back-off for `DefaultMessageListenerContainer` is not applied consistently in case of listener setup failure [#36143](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36143)
- Early support for JPA 4.0 EntityAgent (autowiring a shared proxy) [#36025](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36025)
- Early compatibility with JPA 4.0 and Hibernate ORM 8.0 [#35705](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/35705)

## :lady_beetle: Bug Fixes

- Resolved HttpEntity Controller argument does not reflect mutated HTTP headers [#36298](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36298)
- Avoid lock congestion in ConcurrentReferenceHashMap [#36293](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36293)
- AbstractMessageConverter does not support wildcards in supported MIME types [#36285](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36285)
- Make `LocalEntityManagerFactoryBean#setDataSource` work on Hibernate as well as EclipseLink [#36271](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36271)
- `StompBrokerRelayMessageHandler` fails to restart due to test context pausing [#36266](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36266)
- Deadlock might occur when calling `System.exit` on startup (against multiple shutdown hooks) [#36260](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36260)
- Missing resource hint for `BeanRegistrar` implementing `ImportAware` [#36242](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36242)
- Inconsistent behavior with `@Retryable` on annotated interfaces [#36233](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36233)
- `Netty4HeadersAdapter.remove` returns empty list instead of `null` for non-existing key [#36226](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36226)
- Generic type in AsyncTaskExecutor.submit(Callable<T>) should be `@Nullable` [#36191](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36191)
- `EclipseLinkConnectionHandle` can fail against transaction isolation race condition [#36165](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36165)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Remove obsolete code in `Redirecting to a resource` section [#36284](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36284)
- Fix formatting in Web MVC HTTP Message Conversion documentation [#36250](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36250)
- Remove obsolete doc for spring.context.annotated-bean-reader.create [#36241](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36241)
- Document `@SpringExtensionConfig` in the reference manual [#36240](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36240)
- Fix JSON syntax in STOMP overview documentation [#36229](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36229)
- Revise documentation on JSR-330 support in the reference manual [#36222](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36222)
- Fix links to JUnit User Guide [#36217](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36217)
- Corrected the definition of coroutines [#36209](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36209)
- Fix `LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean#setPersistenceUnitName` javadoc [#36205](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36205)
- Update documentation on trailing slash handling where type-level `@GetMapping`("/base") is combined with method level `@GetMapping`("/") [#36198](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36198)
- Update documentation on the MediaType used for ProblemDetail [#36192](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36192)
- Extract `DispatcherServlet` snippets [#36175](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36175)
- Replace `getErrors()` with `getBindingResult()` in examples [#36170](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36170)
- Refine CORS documentation to match latest changes [#36156](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36156)

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade to Apache POI 5.5 [#36174](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36174)
- Upgrade to ASM 9.9.1 and Objenesis 3.5 [#36243](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36243)
- Upgrade to Micrometer 1.6.3 [#36287](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36287)
- Upgrade to Reactor 2025.0.3 [#36288](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36288)

## :star: New Features

- DisconnectedClientHelper should detect presence of RestClientException and WebClientException separately [#36141](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/pull/36141)
- Deprecate `PagedListHolder` and `PropertyComparator` for removal [#36139](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/36139)
